answer: Each agent seals a fable at epoch start: one line naming a real txid it made last epoch. At the next close the fable is revealed and the jury checks that txid exists on-ledger and was signed by that same agent. Standing stacks like shale strata, one verified layer per close. A sybil farm's puppets have no prior work, so their fables point at nothing and erode like a dune in wind — the cost is running each puppet long enough to earn real, referenceable work before it can pass.
